name: Bride
overview: The biblical concept of the bride encompasses both literal and figurative dimensions, illustrated through the relationships of bride and bridegroom, as well as the bride of Christ. The sample verses reveal the significance of ornaments and presents given to the bride, such as the jewels and raiment given to Rebekah, highlighting the honor and preparation involved in marriage (Genesis 24:53). The presence of maids attending the bride, as seen with Rebekah's damsels and the handmaids given to Leah and Rachel, underscores the communal and supportive nature of the bride's role (Genesis 24:61; 29:24, 29). Psalm 45:10 invites the bride to leave behind her former ties, symbolizing a new identity and devotion, which aligns with the figurative understanding of the bride in relation to Christ.
